items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: I guess it always, it would surprise me that there would be a band like the George Williams band... I heard them on the streets a couple of times... I don't have any real recollection of any sort of distinctive sound or playing that they were doing.

ctx.x: I was just thinking, at a big Sunday school parade, they might have had some bands. You know, they had so many bands, they might have had some bands that would jump up bands, as they called them. Yeah.

I'm, you know, I wasn't aware of that, and I guess it always, it would surprise me that there would be a band like the George Williams band. I had been going parades for a year, year and a half, and had never heard of it, and all of a sudden, there it is, you know, and it's got a drum, and it's got George Williams painted on it, and everything, and so, you know, that, that doesn't mean a whole lot, I guess. But, I remember like Barry Ratton, a couple of weeks ago, had a big banner up, it's embroidered, and it…
I was thinking about, we mentioned Irwin, did the students have any parties?
